content: Pipedrive/HubSpot deactivation flow: on deactivate, admin is shown a summary of items owned by that user (deals, contacts, activities) and must pick a replacement owner before/at deactivation time; bulk-reassign is also available separately via Data cleanup. Best practice explicitly warns against blindly reassigning CLOSED/historical deals to the new owner, since that skews reporting attribution — closed/historical items should keep the original owner's name displayed (deactivated user still shows in ownership field), only OPEN items get reassigned. HubSpot: removed user's records show 'Deactivated/Removed (email)' as owner if not reassigned first.
